words.zupan: (Serbo-Croat) the body governing a zupa, a federation of Serbian villages.
words.zupans: [Plural of ZUPAN] (Serbo-Croat) the body governing a zupa, a federation of Serbian villages.
words.zupas: [Plural of ZUPA] (Serbo-Croat) in early Serbia, a confederation of villages, governed by a zupan.
words.zurf: (Arabic) an ornamental metal holder for a handleless coffee cup, also ZARF.
words.zurfs: [Plural of ZURF] (Arabic) an ornamental metal holder for a handleless coffee cup, also ZARF.
words.zuz: A silver coin of ancient Palestine.
words.zuzim: [Inflection of ZUZ] A silver coin of ancient Palestine.
words.zylonite: A non-thermosetting plastic of the nitrocellulose type, also XYLONITE.
words.zymites: [Plural of ZYMITE] A priest who uses leavened bread.
words.zymomes: [Plural of ZYMOME] An old name for the part of gluten insoluble in alcohol.
words.zymotics: [Plural of ZYMOTIC] Of the nature of, relating to or causing an infectious disease [adj ZYMOTICALLY] / an infectious disease.
words.zythums: [Plural of ZYTHUM] (Greek) a malt beer made by the ancient Egyptians.
words.zzzs: (colloquial) an informal noun for sleep, as in to catch a few zzzs.
